title: boxy green SUV
request: Create a simple car with fewer curves: a modern boxy five-door SUV, green, about 4.6 m long, with a realistic studio render. The person said to start right away with defaults and no questions. Defaults: about 4.6 m long, 1.85 m wide, 1.70 m tall, 2.70 m wheelbase. Flat roof with roof rails, upright windows, short squared hood (about 1.1 m) with its top level with the belt line, not a low ledge below it. Bumpers flush with the body and slatted grille. Mirrors, black trim, dark tinted glass, silver multi-spoke wheels on all-season tyres. Lessons from earlier attempts, please follow them: (1) Paint: dark forest green, base colour about (0.020, 0.080, 0.032), metallic 0.5, roughness 0.45, clearcoat 0.5. Make sure every body face, especially the roof and hood top faces, carries the paint material and not a default white one. Keep the overhead studio light soft (about 40% strength or tilted 30 degrees) so the roof and hood never wash out to near-white; the hood should measure darker than #3A6A45 from every angle. (2) Glass: every window, including the tailgate glass, is a flat closed glass panel set slightly behind its trim frame, with closed shell behind it so no white holes show through. The windscreen must sit firmly in its frame. (3) Wheel arches: squared black cladding bands about 0.07 m wide that follow the arch opening, with chamfered corners, slightly proud of the paint and ending on the side skirt. Not big flat rectangles, and green paint should show around them. (4) Front and rear faces built from clean quads, not triangle fans. (5) Headlamps and tail lamps use emissive materials so they visibly glow. The mesh should be watertight.

spec.summary: A simple, boxy five-door SUV with a flat roof, roof rails, upright windows and a short squared hood. Dark forest green metallic paint contrasts with black trim, dark tinted glass and silver multi-spoke wheels. Built for a realistic studio render with soft overhead light.
materials: dark forest green metallic paint (base colour about 0.020, 0.080, 0.032, metallic 0.5, roughness 0.45, clearcoat 0.5)

parts.name: bumper_rear

spec.notes: Use defaults: wheelbase 2.70 m, short squared hood about 1.1 m. Paint on every body face including roof and hood top, never default white. Soft overhead studio light (about 40% strength or tilted 30 degrees) so the roof and hood never wash out; hood must read darker than #3A6A45 from every angle. Glass is flat, closed and set slightly behind its trim frame, with a closed shell behind it so no white holes show. Wheel arch cladding is squared with chamfered corners. Front and rear faces use clean quads, no triangle fans. Headlamps and tail lamps are emissive. Mesh must be watertight. No questions asked; defaults used throughout.
